description: Find an Oxford Ledge LEARN lesson to teach: 40 learning paths and 433 modules written for lifelong students and investors. No arguments lists the paths plus a start_here module; `path` lists one path's modules in teaching order; `query` searches module titles, section headings and glossary terms ('P/E ratio', 'free cash flow'). Each module row carries module_id, title, level, est_minutes, prereqs, check counts and lesson_url. `completed` (module ids the learner has finished; advisory, never stored) picks start_here and next_up by path order and prerequisites. Teach the module with ol_learn_lesson. Educational content, never a recommendation to buy or sell a security. Source: Oxford Ledge LEARN (authored); FREE for every caller, no key needed.

completed.description: Module ids the learner has finished. Advisory; never stored.

path.description: A path id such as 'valuation-101': list its modules in order.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'P/E ratio'.

name: ol_learn_find
title: Find a Lesson
